entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Frontend-proxy shows sustained high request error rate and error spans, indicating it cannot forward traffic correctly.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alerts for frontend-proxy (warning) and trace span metrics with STATUS_CODE_ERROR increasing after 17:30.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend service lost traffic because upstream frontend-proxy failed, causing downstream 5xx errors.
entities.evidence: Trace critical paths for frontend disappear after 17:30; RequestErrorRate alerts for frontend show high values.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/ad
entities.reasoning: Ad service received error responses due to upstream frontend-proxy failure.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert for ad spikes concurrently with frontend-proxy errors.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/recommendation
entities.reasoning: Recommendation service impacted by loss of traffic from frontend-proxy.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert for recommendation aligns with frontend-proxy error surge.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/fraud-detection
entities.reasoning: Fraud-detection service shows increased error rate as a downstream symptom.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert for fraud-detection appears during the incident window.

propagations.condition: frontend-proxy returns HTTP errors for client requests
propagations.effect: frontend receives no successful traffic, leading to its own error spikes

propagations.condition: frontend forwards requests to ad but receives errors from upstream
propagations.effect: ad reports high request error rate
